reason: Committed-source rule before review findings 3, 11 and 13: it accepted any refs/remotes/origin/ci/* tip as published, including one set locally with update-ref; it checked only closure files, so an untracked or edited agent_tools file outside the closure (readiness_vm_dispatch.json, tool_action_policy.json) passed; requirement-free phases such as scenario-start and facade or hosted boundaries were never checked; and a read-only status of a job submitted from a published ci/* tip was refused once that branch was deleted or a local commit followed.
